race.comment: GHOST GUM (1) is on the quick back-up after just missing at Eagle Farm on debut last week. Is sure to have come on from the experience and keeps BT piloting. Can go one better. KATSUKO (2) is a Tiger Of Malay colt on debut for the Heinrich & Rodgers stable, and looks the main danger off a sharp Gold Coast trial win in readiness. Youngberry's 2kg claim sets him up well at the weights. LA BELLA QUEEN (7) is a Jonker filly also facing the starter for the first time. She too has put a stylish trial win under her belt in the lead-up, and a bright start for her won't shock. CRESCENDOED (5) hails from the handy juvenile stable of Paul Shailer and strips fitter for two lead-up trials. Worth a market watch. BETTER BE DONE (4) has race experience three weeks between runs with improvement to come. In the mix.
